title: manual events.json (INPUT)
description: Human-authored click-anchor file for the MP4 path when no Screenize package exists. Validated on READ by parse_events.py so a typo gives a precise error instead of a KeyError. This is the ONE source of truth for the manual schema — SKILL.md cites this file rather than re-inlining it.

display.description: Optional; parse_events.py defaults to 1920x1080 scale 1 if omitted. Coordinates in clicks[] are already normalized 0..1, so display is informational.
